rationale: CR-001 is resolved. The fix-up adds `except UnreadableWorkbookError: raise` in _load_docs_parallel before the blanket `except Exception`, so the multiprocessing ingestion path now propagates a corrupt/encrypted xlsb (surfacing the actionable error) consistent with the serial path, exactly as recommended. A new test (test_unreadable_workbook_error_propagates) asserts it raises and does not falsely increment skipped_count. The fix-up diff is limited to file_loader.py + its test; it introduces no new high-risk issue (the new except is correctly ordered before the generic handler and distinct from SkippedFileException). 62 tests pass in the affected files; ruff clean. No confirmation-pass fan-out needed.
